primary_goals: Complete a half marathon in under 2:05
maintenance_goals: Keep the squat and pulling strength I have
masters_constrained.equipment: Full commercial gym — barbells, dumbbells, racks, machines, cables, sled, and road access outside.
masters_constrained.current_numbers:
Deadlift: 150 kg x 3
Back Squat: 120 kg x 5
Bench Press: 90 kg x 5
Half marathon: 2:24 six months ago
Current running: 2 runs per week, about 14 km total, longest recent run 9 km
Overhead Press: painful above about 40 kg
masters_constrained.injuries: Right shoulder impingement, ongoing for about 8 months. Overhead pressing and upright rows reproduce a sharp pinch at the top. Bench press, rows and pull-ups are comfortable. No diagnosis or imaging.

pain.description: Right shoulder, sharp pinch at the top of overhead pressing
pain.severity: 4/10 during the movement, settles within an hour
pain.tolerated_movements: Bench press, dumbbell rows, pull-ups, landmine press and carries are all comfortable. Overhead pressing, upright rows and behind-the-neck work are not.

masters_constrained.notes: Shift worker, sleeps 5-6 hours and it varies week to week. Three sessions is a realistic ceiling and 50 minutes is a hard stop. Wants the deadlift and the half marathon at the same time and knows that is greedy. Do not program through shoulder pain.

primary_goals: Full front lever hold for 10 seconds
10 km ruck with 20 kg under 70 minutes
minimal_calisthenics.equipment: Home setup only: pull-up bar, gymnastic rings, parallettes, resistance bands, a 24 kg weight vest and a 20 kg rucksack. No barbell, no dumbbells, no machines.
minimal_calisthenics.current_numbers:
Strict pull-ups: 18 reps
Weighted pull-up: +24 kg x 5
Tuck front lever: 20 seconds
Advanced tuck front lever: 8 seconds
Straddle front lever: 3 seconds
Wall-supported handstand push-up: 6 reps
Freestanding handstand: 25 seconds
10 km ruck with 20 kg: 78 minutes
minimal_calisthenics.notes: Five short sessions suit the schedule better than three long ones, but 45 minutes is a genuine ceiling including warm-up. No external weights beyond the vest and the ruck. Wants the front lever and the ruck time together.
